comment: Level 1 story flow: which lines play, on which trigger, in what order.
notes: Code generated with AI assistance (Claude). Reviewed by team. The words are in story_dialogue.json; this file only refers to them as 'scene.line_id'. 'line_refs_in' lists other data files in which a string '@scene.line_id' is swapped for that line's text at load (Pike's budget refusals, NPC barks, PA calls). OPENING: 'beats' run in order: 'narrate' types one line over the stars, 'stars' fades the star field (alpha 0 = black), 'dialogue' plays lines in the dialogue box ('auto' = seconds each line stays if the player does not press E), 'sfx' plays /assets/audio/<file>.wav, 'title' shows the title card. 'ui' holds dialogue box timings. OBJECTIVES: the tracker's steps in order; the text is story_dialogue.json 'objectives.<id>'. A step is done when its 'complete_on' happens: {'event': id} (a StoryTriggers.fire) or {'area': room id}. Doing a later step early also ticks off the ones before it, but a 'required' step is never skipped. 'done_if_flag' completes a step at once if that flag is already set. TRIGGERS: keyed by the id the world fires (an 'interact' or 'talk' id in facility_world.json, or any StoryTriggers event). Each is a list of cases; the first case whose 'if' flags are all set and 'unless' flags are all unset plays its 'lines', then sets the flags in 'set' and fires the event in 'fire' (objectives listen for those). AUTOPLAY: a trigger that plays by itself 'delay' seconds after the player first walks into 'area'.
